method: Two first-frame sheets and one GIF animation sheet visually inspected. Four GIFs sampled at four spaced positions (both unique S1N6 frames); longer animations not exhaustive. SVG exceptions investigated separately. Exact-source rejections do not exclude other originals.

svg_evidence.method: Four embedded PNG sprite layers, each 1728x72 with 24 frames; frames 0,8,15,23 extracted per layer and visually inspected. Not composited browser playback.
103 CSS keyframe definitions applied to 625 rectangles at first/last keyframe values; rendered endpoints inspected. Not exhaustive 303-second playback.
